title.narrative: Harnessing reactive power for energy efficiency and decarbonisation

description.narrative: The project promotes the large-scale use of reactive power to reduce transmission energy losses and coal-based power generation in Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Uzbekistan. The project consists of two phases: Piloting and Upscaling, whereas the piloting will be conducted only in Kazakhstan to test the technology first and if successful the project will extend to other two countries. Key outcomes include direct emission reductions of 280,189 tCO2 eq. during the project life and 1,028,608 tCO2 eq. over technology lifetime, improved livelihoods, mobilization of finance and increased investor confidence, policy and regulatory changes, and cultural shifts within the region. Project outputs will feature gender lens financing and professional training with a gender focus, incl. educational modules in universities.
